AcceptanceTest is the only test class, and the full suite is green (2/2 passing, BUILD SUCCESS).

## Summary

I implemented telephone normalization on owner create by adding one small step to the existing OfficeFloor pipeline, keeping each unit single-responsibility:

**New pipeline step** — `owners.POST.yml` now runs `ValidateOwnerFields → normalizeTelephone → build → save → respond`. The normalize step sits after the required-fields check (so a present-but-invalid number reaches it) and before build (so the stored/returned value is normalized).

**`NormalizeTelephone`** (`rest/function/owner/`) — reads the republished `@Val OwnerFieldsDto`, strips every non-digit (`replaceAll("\\D", "")`), requires exactly 10 digits, and writes the digits-only value back onto the DTO in place. Because `@Val` yields the same object, `BuildOwner` and later responses see the normalized `telephone`.

**`InvalidTelephoneException`** + **`InvalidTelephoneExceptionHandler`** + escalation YAML — a checked exception rejected as 400 when the stripped value isn't exactly 10 digits, following the existing `MissingRequiredFieldsException` escalation pattern rather than overloading it.

Verified behavior matches the spec via the tests: `"(04) 1234-5678"` → stored/returned as `"0412345678"`, and `"12345"` → 400.
